rationale: A 1h premium-confirmed momentum continuation strategy was tested because H-005 showed that price-only 1h momentum confirmation was not promotable. Premium index pressure is an independent derivatives-market stream that may identify continuation regimes when it aligns with price momentum. RETROSPECTIVE: this plan was authored after execution as part of WP-6c to extend the schema grammar to the remaining concluded candidates. The original H-008 pre-registration lives in research/hypotheses/H-008/HYPOTHESIS.md and was not schema-validated at the time.
hypothesis_to_test: A 1h premium-confirmed momentum continuation strategy on BTCUSDT perpetuals will generate OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs, improve signal selectivity relative to price-only 1h momentum baselines, keep turnover controlled enough that cost drag remains within D2-006 limits, and survive walk-forward validation with efficiency > 0.5.

additional_criteria: OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs
Gate 2 passes under current evaluator semantics: dsr_val > 0.95 versus the expected maximum-SR benchmark from the registered trial count
Max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold
Parameter sensitivity: +/-25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline
No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL
Kill criteria from H-008 HYPOTHESIS.md apply: OOS Sharpe < 0.3, max drawdown > 35%, cost drag > 50% of gross PnL, premium confirmation failure, or domination by too few premium-extreme windows

data_requirements: 8h funding-rate stream for cashflow accounting: funding_8h
The 1h premium index stream has one known irreparable bar in data/irreparable_gaps.json; the baseline handled the affected bar explicitly
No separate IS/OOS split convention existed in repo truth for this baseline; DEC-0008 records full-period Sharpe in both trial-log Sharpe fields
author: WP-6c retrospective
